pairs.subject: import-normalization
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/confirmation.rs:116 the import commit door writes the persona row by raw INSERT, bypassing persona_repo::create (src-tauri/db/src/repos/core/personas.rs:1006) and its name/structured-prompt/budget/turns validators, so a model-authored foreign import lands unvalidated; and :356 commits a partial import whenever at least one entity succeeds, against review-before-commit atomic commit

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/confirmation.rs:116 raw INSERT INTO personas skips the creation door (validate_name, validate_structured_prompt, validate_max_budget_usd, validate_max_turns, validate_notification_channels, name-collision suffixing at personas.rs:1006+); triggers were moved through the door at :203 (commit 21ddcf6322) and tool definitions at :265 are still raw INSERTs. Realized parts: caps with one authority src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_limits.rs:33, prompt-sink sanitization src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/prompts.rs:307, secrets as valueless requirements confirmation.rs:412, channel secrets encrypted confirmation.rs:94

src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/confirmation.rs:356 rolls back only when EVERY entity failed and otherwise commits with errors as warnings, contradicting its own doc at :42-43 ("If ANY entity fails ... rolled back"); :391 the receipt stores only entity_errors, so a clean import enumerates nothing; :252 an incoming tool whose name matches an existing definition silently reuses it, a silent collision default. Staged-first receipt is realized at :58

src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/prompts.rs:311 (and :417) load platform_rules::builtin_n8n() for every transform; start_n8n_transform_background (cli_runner.rs:40) takes no source-platform argument, so a Zapier/Make/GitHub-Actions import detected client-side is transformed under the n8n credential-consolidation table; NodeTypeMapping (src-tauri/core/src/models/platform_definition.rs:42) has no grade column, so the table cannot feed a loss ledger

src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/types.rs:4 N8nPersonaOutput, the shape that crosses into the commit door, carries no per-entity provenance (foreign id, source format/version) or conversion grade, so nothing provenance-based (re-import matching, receipt enumeration) is possible downstream

src-tauri/src/commands/design/n8n_transform/confirmation.rs:391 no loss ledger reaches the commit layer and the durable receipt records errors only, so "why does this imported persona lack behavior" cannot be answered after the wizard closes

pairs.registryProposal: rust--import-validation.md (verified 2026-08-18) lists the commit door as "Atomic commit ... Any entity failure rolls back the whole transaction"; the code at confirmation.rs:349-378 rolls back only on total failure and commits partial imports, and the persona row bypasses the repo creation door. The application should be re-verified and its "Confirmed" bullet moved to divergences.
